name: Liv Calloway
source:
Grew up in a hydro-dome colony near Europa, where the aquatic frontier was as beautiful as it was unforgiving. She's served under [url=/c166741]Veronica[/url] for several years before this mission, earning her trust through steady competence. Clean, methodical, and gentle by nature, though Europa taught her that compassion sometimes demands hard choices.
